correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the edge predicates using the minimal common face. Shared active coordinate constraints fix the coordinates outside the symmetric difference. For ideals the remaining shared equations identify comparable coordinates; opposite differences of two ideals are incomparable. For antichains a common tight chain either meets a common vertex or imposes x_i+x_j=1 across the two differences for a comparable pair. Thus the remaining dimension is the number of connected components in each case. Independently generated every naturally labelled order by adding the last element over any ideal of its predecessors, without using the X-free skip, then computed both diameters by exact bit-set breadth-first search. There are no splits at n=0 through 6. For n=4,5,6,7 the totals are 40,357,4824,96428; X counts are 0,1,66,3705. All 46 splits are (2,3), and direct comparison with all relabelings of Lee's witness and its transpose gives disjoint groups of 23 each. Linear extensions ensure all isomorphism types are included; order duality complements ideal coordinates and preserves comparabilities for antichains.
residual_risks: The classification ends at seven elements. The witness is cited by a different proposition number in the frozen text; in arXiv v3 the verified locator is Example 5 and Proposition 24(i).

value.rationale: The graph diameter distinguishes two natural polytopes whose vertex and edge counts agree. Determining exactly when this distance invariant first distinguishes them, and showing that the known example is forced up to duality at that size, supplies a sharp structural cutoff rather than another example.
residual_risks: No general characterization for larger posets is supplied or needed for this contribution.
